about: What the tools tracker reads (tools-tracker-20261019.html). worlds: one row per world, pointing at that world's tools-by-floor ledger; refs are tried in order, so a ledger still on a branch is found there until it merges to main. tools: Astra's or an agent's notes on each tool, keyed by the tool id used in the ledgers. The same id in two worlds is the same tool. readiness is one of: not rated, getting better, ready to package.
